program.section_heading: Medical Administrative Assistant Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate foundational ethical awareness and responsible application and use of data from Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) powered applications. Students will identify, explain, and apply best practices for integrating GenAI data and information into administrative professional documents and workplace tasks.
Demonstrate ability to perform office tasks in a medical office, including scheduling appointments, maintaining medical records, bookkeeping, and managing patient information.
Demonstrate knowledge and use of keyboarding and/or computer applications used in the business segment of a medical office setting.
